author: Dawudis
body:
When I was on a nexus game, I reported a "hacker for aimbot". He hit me while he wasn't looking at me. He hits two people at the same time etc. Anyway, there was a mod on the game, and he did not do anything! Aren't mods supposed to get the memo that Username reported Username?! He stayed on the same team as the "hacker" and made it seem like nothing ever happened. Every single game, the "hacker" would join the mods team?! Isn't that a little suspicious to you mods??? 

A few days ago, my sister even reported someone for hacks, yet the mods did nothing!
Can you guys fix this... please just do it!

title: Why... Just Why?

replies.author: hpux
replies.body: If you have a problem with a specific staff member, you can report him or her to Howsie. However, the staff could have been afk, deemed the player as "clean", meaning he didn't have hacks, or the staff was just watching him for a long time.

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Staff members tend to answer as many in-game reports as possible. However, if you believe that a staff member is not doing his job correctly, you can either report them via Skype to a Sr. Mod+ or E-mail support@avicus.net.

However, you can make an online report regarding this player.

replies.author: Riskayyy
replies.body:
Hello EnderPearlReaper,
If you feel a staff member's decision was unjust or incorrect, please e-mail support@avicus.net with suffice evidence and a clear description detailing the situation. 

If you don't want to take this issue that far, please record the accused player; then file an online report.

replies.body: KK, that was really helpful info, I will send my complaint to the support@avicus.net. However, if you could somehow tell me the skype of a sr.mod, it would be much easier, then again thanks.

replies.author: TheMasterCow
replies.body: No need to specifically inquire to a senior staff's skype, however you can ask them on external services. Most skypes are not handed out for confidential reasons (usually security) but try asking some of your friends for it or guessing names. Otherwise, email support@avicus.net and keep it there for now.
